title: swing hat study
code:
samples('github:eddyflux/crate')

setcpm(68/4)

let chords = chord("<Bbm9 Eb13 Ab^9 F7#9>").dict('ireal')

let hatsC = s(`[hh ~ hh] [hh hh hh] [hh ~ hh] <
    [hh hh hh hh]!3 [hh hh hh oh:2]
    [hh hh hh hh]!3 [hh hh oh:13@2]
  >`)
  .velocity(`[1 .6 .6] [.85 .5 .65] [1 .6 .6] <
    [.8 .5 .6 .45]!3 [.8 .5 .6 .8]
    [.8 .5 .6 .45]!3 [.8 .5 .85@2]
  >`)
  .room("0 0 0 <0!7 [0 0 .8@2]>")

let kick = s("bd ~ ~ [~ bd] ~ bd ~ ~")
let snare = s("~ [rim, sd:<2 3>] ~ [rim, sd:<2 3>]").late(.01)

let partA = stack(
  stack(
    kick,
    snare,
    hatsC,
  ).bank('crate').gain(.55),

  chords.anchor("c5").voicing()
    .s("gm_epiano1:1")
    .room(.4).lpf(2400)
    .gain(.45),

  n("0 ~ ~ [~ 0]").set(chords).mode("root:g2").voicing()
    .s("gm_acoustic_bass")
    .gain(.6),

  stack(
    note(`<
      [~ ab4 c5@2]
      [c5@2 [g4 bb4 db5]@2]
      [c5 ~ g4@2]
      [a4 [ab4@1.1 a4@0.9] c5 eb5]
      [db5 [c5 bb4] ab4]
      [g4@3 bb4]
      [c5 eb5 [d5 c5]]
      [ab4 a4@3]
    >`)
      .mask("<1!22 0 1>"),
    note("[g4 [bb4 c5] eb5]").mask("<0!22 1 0>"),
    note(`<
      [~ ~ ~ ~]
      [~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ b4]]
      [~ ~ ~ ~]
      [~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ eb5]]
      ~ ~ ~ ~
    >`)
      .late(1/32)
      .velocity(.75)
      .penv(1).pattack(.06),
  )
    .s("sine")
    .fm(2.5).fmh(1)
    .fmdecay(.3).fmsustain(.15)
    .add(note("0,.15"))
    .add(note(perlin.range(-.2, .2).slow(3)))
    .attack(.005).decay(.8).sustain(.25).release(.3)
    .lpf(2500)
    .late(.015)
    .delay(.2).room(.35)
    .gain(.38)
    .mask("<0!8 1!16>"),
)

let halfChords = chords.slow(2)

let partB = stack(
  stack(
    kick,
    snare,
    s("hh*4").velocity("1 .7 .85 .7"),
  ).bank('crate').gain(.55),

  s("<[oh:2 ~ ~] [~ ~ oh:2]>").bank('crate').velocity(.6).gain(.55),
  note(`<
    [~ ab4 bb4] [db5 c5 ~]
    [~ bb4 c5] [db5 bb4 ~]
    [~ g4 ab4] [c5 bb4 ~]
    [~ a4 c5] [eb5 c5 ~]
  >`)
    .late("<0 [.02 .035 0]>")
    .add(note("0,-12"))
    .s("gm_drawbar_organ")
    .clip("<[.7 .7 .7] [.7 2.85 .7]>")
    .decay("<[.01 .01 .01] [.01 3.3 .01]>")
    .sustain("<[1 1 1] [1 0 1]>")
    .vib("6:.08")
    .delay(.45).delaytime(60/68 * 2/3).delayfeedback(.5)
    .room(.6).roomsize(4)
    .orbit(2)
    .gain(.35),

  halfChords.anchor("c5").voicing()
    .s("gm_epiano1:1")
    .room(.4).lpf(2400)
    .gain(.45),

  n("0 ~ ~ [~ 0]").set(halfChords).mode("root:g2").voicing()
    .s("gm_acoustic_bass")
    .gain(.6),
)

let partC = stack(
  kick.mask("<1!6 0!2>").bank('crate').gain(.55),
  s("~ hh ~ hh").late(.01).bank('crate').gain(.7),

  note(`<
    [gb2,db3,ab3]
    [ab2,eb3,bb3]
    [db3,ab3,eb4]
    [f2,c3,bb3]
  >/2`)
    .s("triangle")
    .attack(.4).release(2)
    .lpf(1000)
    .room(.7).roomsize(6)
    .gain(.3),
)

arrange([24, partA], [16, partB], [8, partC])
